restart_base.jpeg, restart_changed.jpeg, restart_later.jpeg

Baseline 4:2:0, 193x131, quality 80, one restart interval per MCU.
Generated by the independent encodeQuantized420Restart Go test oracle, without
using the production GPU shader or the compressed crop implementation.

For MCU m, component block b (four Y, then Cb and Cr), initialize 64 coefficients:
  DC = (m*17+b*3)%511 - 255
  natural-order AC coefficient 1 = m%7 - 3
  all other AC coefficients = 0

changed additionally sets coefficient 1 of block 0 in MCU (4,4) to 21.
later retains that change and sets coefficient 1 of block 0 in MCU (12,8) to -21.
The corresponding 64x64 dirty regions are (64,64,64,64) and (192,128,1,3).
